title: Guarded SmartDCA safety-adaptivity empirical evaluation
registration_statement: This protocol was frozen before any confirmatory historical price outcome or derived policy result was retrieved, computed, or inspected. Confirmatory choices require a new protocol identity rather than an edit after outcome access.

historical_datasets.asset_semantics: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust as an investable S&P 500 proxy
historical_datasets.adjustment_semantics: provider adjusted close incorporating historical split and dividend events
historical_datasets.retrieval_rule: After protocol lock, make one authenticated full-history CSV request and persist its exact response body before parsing; never place the API key in a receipt.
historical_datasets.fingerprint_rule: SHA-256 of the exact persisted response-body bytes before parsing
historical_datasets.redistribution: Do not commit raw provider bytes until ticket 04 records a license review; retain an immutable local input or a receipt sufficient for authorized reacquisition.

historical_datasets.asset_semantics: Bitcoin spot quoted in US dollars, with no dividend, split, or total-return adjustment
historical_datasets.adjustment_semantics: unadjusted daily spot close quoted in USD and refreshed at midnight UTC
historical_datasets.retrieval_rule: After protocol lock, make one authenticated daily CSV request and persist its exact response body before parsing; never place the API key in a receipt.
historical_datasets.fingerprint_rule: SHA-256 of the exact persisted response-body bytes before parsing
historical_datasets.redistribution: Do not commit raw provider bytes until ticket 04 records a license review; retain an immutable local input or a receipt sufficient for authorized reacquisition.

retrieval_and_fingerprint.refresh_rule: A changed response creates a new input version and cannot replace a confirmatory input receipt in place.

episode_design.nominal_start_rule: first calendar day of each month
episode_design.deposit_count_rule: For horizon H, include exactly H deposits at nominal start plus k calendar months for k=0 through H-1; the horizon date receives no deposit.
episode_design.episode_start_grid_rule: For each dataset and horizon H, use every first-of-month nominal start on or after eligible_start whose nominal start plus H calendar months is on or before data_cutoff.
episode_design.horizon_date_rule: The exact horizon date is the nominal episode start plus H calendar months, before any observation-date mapping.
episode_design.purchase_mapping: first eligible observation on or after each nominal monthly deposit date
episode_design.evaluation_convention: last eligible observation on or before the exact calendar horizon date
episode_design.missing_data_rule: No interpolation or price carry. SPY purchase mapping may move forward at most 7 calendar days; BTC mapping may move forward at most 1 calendar day. Evaluation mapping may move backward by the same asset-specific tolerance. Otherwise exclude the episode.
episode_design.duplicate_mapping_rule: Reject an episode if two nominal deposit dates map to the same observation.
episode_design.information_rule: A policy receives only observations through the current purchase date.
episode_design.terminal_wealth_rule: unspent cash plus terminal asset units times the common evaluation price

primary.selection_reason: the theoretically admissible countercyclical diagonal baseline, fixed without historical outcome access

cost_scenarios.accounting_rule: asset notional equals the selected cash budget
fee equals 10 basis points of asset notional and notional plus fee cannot exceed the selected cash budget
a one-dollar fee applies only when the selected cash budget exceeds one dollar; otherwise no purchase or fee occurs

hypotheses.scope: each declared asset, primary horizon, and non-unit primary coverage under the primary corrected configuration and frictionless accounting
each declared asset, primary horizon, and non-unit primary coverage under the primary corrected configuration and frictionless accounting

multiplicity.family: 36 confirmatory tests: 2 assets x 3 horizons x 3 non-unit primary coverage levels x 2 confirmatory comparisons
multiplicity.unit_coverage_boundary: lambda=1 is an accounting invariant and is not included as a statistical test

uncertainty.rng: CPython 3.12 random.Random using MT19937 and randrange(N) for each block-start draw
uncertainty.cell_seed_rule: For each cell, take the first 16 hexadecimal digits of SHA-256 over UTF-8 '<seed>|<dataset_id>|<horizon_months>|<coverage>|<comparison>|<corrected_mean_config>|<cost_scenario>' as an unsigned base-16 integer; this makes cells order-independent.
uncertainty.block_rule: block length equals the episode horizon measured in one-month rolling-stride units
uncertainty.block_construction: Within one dataset-horizon cell, sort the N included episode estimands by nominal start. For each replicate, draw circular block starts independently and uniformly from integers 0 through N-1, append L consecutive values modulo N for each draw, and truncate the final block so the resample contains exactly N values.
uncertainty.replicate_statistic: Recompute the registered cell estimand on each N-value resample; the confirmatory statistic is the median relative terminal-wealth gap.
uncertainty.quantile_rule: For probability p, sort the B uncentered replicate statistics and linearly interpolate at zero-based position (B-1)*p between its floor and ceiling indices.
uncertainty.p_value: For observed statistic T and replicate statistics T_b under null value zero, use the centered two-sided tail count abs(T_b-T) >= abs(T).
uncertainty.p_value_finite_sample_rule: The unadjusted p-value is (1 + the centered two-sided tail count) / (B + 1).
uncertainty.holm_order: Sort by unadjusted p-value, then dataset_id, horizon_months, numeric coverage, comparison in H1-before-H2 order, corrected_mean_config, and cost_scenario; apply standard step-down Holm adjusted p-values with cumulative maxima capped at one.

confirmatory: H1 and H2 on SPY adjusted daily and BTC/USD daily
the registered estimands, block bootstrap, and Holm family
secondary: mechanism, downside, exposure, cash, unit, activation, and purchase summaries
robustness: the four declared corrected-mean robustness configurations
quarterly-first-eligible-observation deposits with a three-month rolling stride
analysis_tiers.immutability_rule: Confirmatory datasets, hypotheses, estimands, grids, and inference choices cannot change after confirmatory outcome access. Any change requires a new protocol_id and is not confirmatory under this registration.

canonical_run.purpose: exercise the complete runner without inspecting confirmatory historical outcomes

runner_contract.collision_rule: an existing output directory with the deterministic run identity fails before policy execution
